archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Tactile Developer-Tool & Solana Coin-Launcher Hybrid)
emotional_tone: High-velocity, precise, sovereign, hacker-refined crypto engineering

backend_proxy_architecture.backend_url: FastAPI backend running at process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or /api
proxied_endpoints: /api/stats - Live relayed stats (total coins, SOL volume, total trades, total market cap)
/api/explore - Live relayed coin feed with filters (Just Launched, Top Volume, Hot Rules)
/api/scoreboard - Live relayed leaderboard (top coins, top rule creators, payout totals)
/api/img/* - Image proxy for token avatars and rule diagram assets
/api/build - Relays rule sentence / block configurations to circuitdev.fun
backend_proxy_architecture.action_forwarding: All deploy, wallet connect, and live execution receipt links forward seamlessly to https://circuitdev.fun

EV_event.label: EV
EV_event.description: Event trigger block (rounded top, starts execution flow)

LG_logic.label: LG
LG_logic.description: Logic block (condition check e.g. price / market cap threshold)

font_files.mono_code: JetBrains Mono or Fira Code (monospace for math, block numbers, rules)

logo_design.part_2: DEV (Bold Mint Green #4ADE80 text with terminal underscore or dot)
logo_design.container: flex items-center gap-2 font-mono text-xl font-bold tracking-wider

sidebar.active_item_style: bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 font-semibold shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(74,222,128,0.15)] rounded-lg py-2.5 px-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all
sidebar.inactive_item_style: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-900/60 rounded-lg py-2.5 px-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all
sidebar.bottom_cta: Large bright mint-green rounded button 'Deploy a coin' with dark text (bg-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-300 text-slate-950 font-extrabold w-full shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 py-3 rounded-xl)

main_canvas.bg_pattern: subtle dot-grid background (radial-gradient white dot grid 1px on #070B0E)

1_live_stats_strip.description: Top or inline horizontal strip with live proxy stats (Total Coins Launched, SOL Volume Traded, Total Block Executions, Market Cap)
1_live_stats_strip.animation: Pulse indicator dot green + smooth counter updates

2_hero_sentence_builder.description: Interactive sentence prompt: 'One sentence becomes rule blocks that run a coin.' Users type or select templates (e.g. 'When market cap hits 100k SOL, buy 5% back and burn'). Instant real-time transformation into puzzle-piece rule blocks.
2_hero_sentence_builder.forward_action: Clicking 'Launch Rules on Solana' packages rule JSON and opens circuitdev.fun/start

3_interactive_block_canvas.description: Visual puzzle-piece canvas showing snapped EV (Amber Event), LG (Teal Logic), and FN (Yellow Function) blocks with rounded tab connectors, inline white pill select inputs, blue percentage chips (%2.5), and yellow amount chips (10 SOL). Includes drag/reorder preview, adding new blocks, and block count pill ('5 blocks').

4_explore_coins_grid.description: Grid of relayed coin cards with proxied images (/api/img/*), live progress bars, fee rule summary tags, creator wallets, market cap, and direct receipt button linking to circuitdev.fun/c/[address].

5_scoreboard_leaderboard.description: Relayed leaderboard showing top performing rule-run coins, creator earnings, rule execution receipts count, and total SOL deposited in vaults.

6_editorial_marquee.description: Option A slow drift marquee displaying recent live execution receipts, rule block events, and trending ticker tags.

motion_and_libraries.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll engine initialized globally
motion_and_libraries.animations: Framer Motion for block snapping, hero reveal stagger, tab switching, hover micro-interactions

image_urls.description: Vertical columns of glowing green digital code on black
Colorful computer code on dark screen

testing_requirements.rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, stat items, coin cards, and canvas block elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all data displayed in components (stats, coins, scoreboard) is fetched from the FastAPI backend proxy (/api/stats, /api/explore, /api/scoreboard).
Implement the CodePad-style two-tone logo ('CIRCUIT' in white + 'DEV' in mint green).
Build the sidebar navigation with the dark-green active pill style and the prominent bright mint-green 'Deploy a coin' button.
Implement the block-builder canvas with EV/LG/FN badge chips, puzzle tab/notch connectors, blue % chips, yellow amount chips, and white pill inputs.
Include Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion block animation micro-interactions.
Ensure all external actions (Deploy, Build, Receipt links) forward cleanly to circuitdev.fun.
